codec_source: Canonical deobfuscated classes in fixture Paper 26.3 server JAR, inspected using Java 25 javap -c -p; packet registration facts retained in schema/packet-ids.json; decompiled extracts excluded from distribution
protocol_client: Python standard library sockets, zlib, struct; exact login/configuration/play wire framing. No Player proxy, EmbeddedChannel, or sample injection is used in joined-client suite.
limitations: Not an official Mojang rendered client
No Microsoft authentication; test usernames have offline UUIDs
Only implemented packet types are decoded; unrelated received packets are counted and ignored
No global claim of Mineflayer/Prismarine released support for 26.3
